issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other: Water Fund 31,802.52 + Sewer Fund 12,785.83
issues.issue: These are the only receipts of the Water and Sewer funds, so they are almost certainly water/sewer charges (charges for services/fees). Recording them as 'other' with review is defensible but leaves 100% of business-type receipts in 'other'.
Nothing on the page breaks this line down, so 'other' with review is acceptable. It is 39% of governmental receipts (90,685.96), over the 10% review threshold.
Principal and interest are combined on one line and the page gives no split. Defensible, already marked review.

issues.on_page: Sewer Fund -> Reserve Fund 10,000.00; General Fund -> Street Fund 6,500.00
issues.issue: The Reserve Fund's only receipts are the 10,000 transfer from the Sewer Fund, so it may be a sewer/utility reserve (business-type) rather than a governmental fund. The extractor treated it as governmental, which makes this a 10,000 cross-type transfer that raises governmental cash. This is a judgment call; consider a decision_needed entry.
